channel.title: Boulder Daily Camera - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder Daily Camera (dailycamera.com)

item.title: Zyanna Walker eager for return to K-State, leading CU Buffs into Big 12 road test
item.description: During the previous two years, Zyanna Walker made some great memories and played in big games for Kansas State. On Thursday, she’ll get a different perspective of Bramlage Coliseum in Manhattan, Kansas.

item.title: Boulder Valley to make school consolidation, reconfiguration recommendations in fall
item.description: Boulder Valley leaders at Tuesday's school board meeting outlined a timeline and plan to gather community feedback as the district develops declining enrollment solutions that could include consolidating schools, reconfiguring grade levels and relocating programs.

item.title: Allenspark family fled burning home as ceiling started to cave in
item.description: Allenspark resident Betty Edwards recalled seeing the deck of her family's home go up in flames in just minutes.

item.title: Broncos QB Bo Nix denies ‘any predisposed issues’ with ankle, clarifies 4-6 week recovery timeline
item.description: Bo Nix wants the world to know: he has no concerns, moving forward in his career, that he's any kind of injury-prone quarterback.

item.title: Jury finds former Colorado senator guilty of four felonies for faked letters of support in probe
item.description: The falsely attributed letters drew the attention of the Denver District Attorney’s Office, which brought the felony charges against Jaquez Lewis.

item.title: Front Range prep events to watch this weekend
item.description: Frederick boys look to get back on track, while stars meet up in Broomfield-Monarch girls hoops game.

item.title: TikTok star Shirley Raines, known for bringing meals and respect to people on LA’s Skid Row, dies at 58
item.description: Raines began working with homeless communities in 2017.

item.title: Skyline girls basketball, under Tobin Skenandore, is changing the tides
item.description: That kind of excitement has become a hallmark of head coach Tobin Skenandore’s first season with the Falcons, and it’s already paying dividends for a once struggling program.

item.title: Power returns to more than 4,000 customers in Lafayette, Louisville areas
item.description: Over 4,000 people are without power in the Lafayette and Louisville areas on Wednesday night.

item.title: Boulder County residents tell PUC their power-outage stories
item.description: Boulder County residents and officials voiced their frustrations with Xcel Energy on Wednesday.
